notes.title: Nice to Meet You, Steam!
notes.content: [h3][b]■Introduction[/b][/h3][p]Nice to Meet You, Steam![/p][p]Hello everyone! I’m [b]Fukudanuki[/b], the developer of [b]Beautiful Life Show[/b].[/p][p]Thank you so much for supporting [b]Beautiful Life Show[/b]![/p][p]Up until now, we’ve mainly been sharing development updates on social media like X (formerly Twitter) for our Japanese audience,[/p][p]but with our upcoming exhibition at Tokyo Game Show (TGS) from September 25–28,[/p][p]we’ve decided to start posting more regular development updates here as well.[/p][p]We’re still getting used to this platform,[/p][p]so we’d really appreciate your patience and warm support as we get started![/p][p]At this year’s TGS, we’ll be showcasing a playable demo at the iGi/Sofu booth in Halls 9–11 (International Exhibition Hall).[/p][p]If you’re planning to attend, please feel free to stop by and give it a try![/p]
